mainEntity.name: What is the average cost range for a kitchen remodel in Meridian, Idaho?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen remodel costs in Meridian can vary widely based on the size of your kitchen, the quality of materials chosen, and the extent of the renovation. A minor refresh might start around $15,000-$30,000, while a mid-range remodel could be $30,000-$75,000. A high-end, custom kitchen renovation with premium finishes and significant layout changes can exceed $75,000. These figures are estimates, and a detailed consultation helps us provide a precise quote based on your specific vision and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Average kitchen remodel costs in Meridian range from $15,000 for a minor refresh to over $75,000 for a high-end, custom renovation.
